label: ① Frontend Design：私人献辞
direction: Bespoke dedication composition. One memorable structural move, all else quiet. Compact custom geometric wordmark and elegant regular-weight contemporary sans, inspired by Afacad rather than a generic high-contrast luxury serif. Mineral white, near-black, quiet greys, a tiny dried-wine action accent. Build the opening around a private dedication situated between two unlike works, as though the website itself is addressing a person. This is editorial web typography, not a letter/envelope prop. The tall sheep and a smaller vivid pixel artwork should occupy deliberately unequal, offset positions without becoming a standard left-copy/right-picture hero. The short giving invitation occupies the negative space naturally left by the works. Show that the same exact typographic/spacing language continues into a following small collection teaser. No accessory decoration, ornamental rules or art-derived site palette. The image pairing, delicate wordmark and dedication line create this product's particular identity.

label: ② UI/UX Pro Max：清晰的精品选礼入口
direction: Use the verified Minimalism & Swiss Style guidance: a precise twelve-column logic, generous white space, monochrome white/black, geometric sans typography at regular-to-medium weights, strong legibility and an obvious next action, essentially no shadows, no gradients and no decorative textures. Reject Liquid Glass, feature-card grids, gold luxury shorthand and social-proof sections. Turn the product task into an exceptionally clear boutique opening: restrained brand/navigation, a single selected artwork emphasized through scale, the contrasting artwork introduced quietly, and an understated service-oriented invitation into choosing a gift. Group information by proximity; only one dominant action. Design should feel easy and intentional at realistic UI sizes, not an oversized arts poster. Clear user journey and progressively revealed information are this direction's main quality, but the image remains a calm premium homepage, not an application dashboard.

label: ③ Taste Skill：错落展陈
direction: Adopt the actually dealt 'Photographs at uneven sizes' / 'Three prints, one line' composition, translated into ARTWORKS instead of unrelated photographs. A twelve-column frame with 5–7% margins. Three works share one high hanging baseline but have unequal widths and dramatically different lower edges: a small square pixel artwork on the left, the largest tall sheep artwork off-center, a smaller wide abstract work farther right; leave real empty columns between them. The brief invitation and primary action sit under the small left artwork rather than forming a conventional hero copy column above it. Archivo-like sturdy grotesk at REGULAR weight, not bold; small calm captions. The dealt palette is deep forest #0f1f10 with white ink and a very pale muted lime #c6f19d used only for one quiet action. It must look expensive and calm, not neon. Do not tint the artwork into forest colors. Continue with an offset pair at the lower edge. No borders-as-decoration, gradients, glows, stock photography, or rows of identical cards.

label: ④ Hallmark：Atelier 艺术沙龙
direction: Use the genuinely dealt Hallmark ATELIER theme: softly luminous mineral paper ground, deep umber/charcoal ink, Sentient-like light ROMAN serif over Hanken Grotesk-like functional sans, one cool slate action signal. Interpret the 'Gallery Hang / Diffusion' material as a flat web surface with quiet lightness differences, NOT a photograph of a room, furniture, picture frames or actual sunlight shadows. A centered restrained wordmark and two plain utility links introduce a delicate open composition of two very different artworks. The artworks are surrounded by generous unpainted space, captions are small and exact, and typography has effortless boutique confidence. The primary gifting invitation belongs in the flow of the collection, without oversized sales copy or a conspicuous filled capsule. Maintain one thought per region and a considered glimpse of the next grouping. No grains added to the artworks, no serif italic accent word, no gold, cute platform motifs, pills, badges, thick outlines or repeated card shells.

label: ⑤ Impeccable：一对一选礼礼宾
direction: Experience mode, recipient-led ART DEDICATION SERVICE. The world is a personal commission/dedication studio, translated into a modern website, not a picture of a desk, book or tool. The product's mechanism is sending a considered work to a particular .ai identity. Make one compact elegant recipient-name line part of the viewing experience, labeled '为谁挑选', with an example placeholder '朋友的 .ai 名字'; it must be as quiet as a bespoke service, not a giant TO graphic or checkout form. The work still leads from the first viewport, with the tall sheep and a contrasting pixel work in a composition that does NOT reduce to a left-copy/right-picture hero. Calm mineral-grey and black with a tiny restrained copper-red functional accent, an own-world readable typographic voice. Only the focused artwork reveals its concise description; the other recedes slightly through interface hierarchy without dimming or tinting the actual art. Make the main action unmistakable and the lower continuation legible. The signature is giving a specific person a work, not displaying an inventory. No streaming catalogue rows, cartoon mascot, clay tower, alphabet storm or illuminated manuscript ornament.

label: ⑥ 花叔 Design：生辰画册
direction: A high-fidelity authored bilingual ART EDITORIAL HOMEPAGE. Think of a beautifully paced art publication's typographic logic, but this is entirely a flat functional website, not a physical book mockup. Neutral porcelain-grey ground, rich black text, a single very small cinnabar functional detail. Refined modern Chinese Song typography paired with a quiet Latin serif; no calligraphy, ink-wash website background, beige nostalgia or gold ornament. Use the opening's typographic arrangement as the memorable move: a slim vertical Chinese invitation near a deliberate central gutter, while two intact heterogeneous artworks occupy unequal but balanced open fields on either side. Place the colorful pixel work at serious artwork scale, not a cute accent sticker; the sheep remains its own independent work. A restrained wordmark, plain navigation, quiet captions and one obvious gift-discovery link make the page usable. The lower section continues the editorial rhythm in a different arrangement.
